chunks: Musa ibn al-Qasim from Abd al-Rahman from Safwan ibn Mihran said:
I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: 'The throwing of the Jamarat is between the sunrise and its sunset.'

key_terms.رَمْيُ الْجِمَارِ: Throwing of the pebbles (ritual act in Hajj)

ai.seo_question: What is the valid time for throwing the Jamarat during Hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the temporal validity of Ramy al-Jimar, establishing a broad window from sunrise to sunset rather than a single fixed hour. This ruling is significant in Shia jurisprudence as it allows for flexibility in performing the ritual during the days of Tashriq, accommodating the pilgrim's ability to reach the Jamarat. It underscores the practical ease (taysir) intended by the Imams in the performance of Hajj rites.
